question: How is the ideal of royal heroism and duty embodied in this figure?
premises: He embodies the heroic duty of the Kakutstha lineage.
He bears the burden of royal duty.
Both epithets stress responsibility and valor.
inference: This figure perfectly upholds the heroic and royal duties of his lineage.
plain_english: He embodies the heroic duty of the Kakutstha line and bears the burden of royal duty.
